description:
Read back a Zorvu Shield receipt by its id: the record of a pre-sign check that was kept at the caller's request, with the verdict, the reason codes with what kind of finding each was (`finding_type`, null on a receipt kept before Zorvu recorded it), the checks that ran, what each checked token came back as, and the time of every reading the verdict rested on.

Useful for showing what was checked before a transaction was signed, or for verifying a receipt someone hands over. A receipt exists only when the precheck call asked for one with `receipt: true`; nothing is kept otherwise and there is no way to list receipts. The id is the only access control, so it works like a link to a private page.

`response_sha256` makes the record tamper-evident: drop `response_sha256` and `disclaimer`, sort the remaining keys, serialise with no whitespace, SHA-256 that, and it matches. `request_sha256` is the hash of the request body as Zorvu received it, so whoever holds that body can prove which transaction was checked. Zorvu does not keep the body itself, the sender, the calldata, the intended size or the caller's own policy. The `to` address is kept only when Zorvu's code read found contract code at it: `to_kind` says `contract`, `wallet` or `unknown`, and for the last two the address itself is not in the receipt at all.

A receipt is a measurement of what Zorvu's checks returned at that time. It is not an audit, a certification or a guarantee, and not financial advice.

id.description: The receipt id a precheck_transaction call returned in receipt.id.

name: get_receipt

finding_type.description: What kind of finding this was (see precheck_transaction). null on a receipt kept before Zorvu recorded it.

to.description: The transaction's to address, kept only when Zorvu's code read found contract code at it; otherwise null.

to_kind.description: What the code read found at the to address: a contract, a plain wallet (no code), or unknown (the read did not run). Only 'contract' keeps the address.

title: Read a Shield receipt
